scripts.build: node scripts/check-module-names.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-app-fixtures.mjs
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src tests scripts screen-ui acceptance vite.config.ts
scripts.test: node --test scripts/check-module-names.test.mjs && tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cadence-ui-tests.XXXXXX") && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"' EXIT && tsrs -p tsconfig.tests.json --outDir "$tmp_dir" && for t in "$tmp_dir"/tests/*.test.js; do NODE_PATH="$PWD/node_modules" node "$t" || exit 1; done && node scripts/build-app-fixtures.mjs && for check in drift-acceptance tag-base-acceptance; do status=0; bash "scripts/app-fixtures/$check.sh" || status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 77 ] && [ -z "${CI:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "SKIP $check: source or prerequisites are not in acceptance-ready state (local non-CI run)"; elif [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$status"; fi; done
